lines.l: Trains are made for everyone, not just for the elite
Through the windows of a train, you can feel a mild heartbeat
Train the train, like jealous lovers in the rain
Oh yeah
They bow and kiss and greet the darkest sky blue
Feel them inside the tears in the morning dew
Our crimson breeze and golden hue
And everything to live and everyone to die
Till the fall are new
Until the sea burst
Can anyone or anything fill this thirst
For love, train to train
Like jealous lovers in the rain
Train to train
Silhouette, a maple leaf shine on a velvet green lawn
Moving over me, a never-ending hand of grace
The subtle touch of the dawn
Dark clock foreboding in the sky
Trickles of rain
I feel the chill, the chill
And the wetness on the windowsill
A chill, the chill
And the wetness on the windowsill
My legs are closed
Green, gray, red and gold
Worn my skin
But my ears are still cold
The wave of joy
That's sweeping into bliss
Learn to be acknowledged, acknowledge and kiss
Train to train
Like yellow slippers in the rain
Train to train
Train to train
Train to train
